Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside, especially when it rained. One day, Timmy's mom took him to a fancy school where they had to wear cool clothes. Timmy thought that was funny, so he laughed and laughed.

But then, Timmy started to feel bad. He remembered that the fancy school had some weird hats on them. Timmy's mom told him that nature is cool and special. Timmy didn't like them, but he didn't think of them.

Timmy's Mom told him that the fancy hat was special and special to her.
